title: Ephemeral STS session tags dropped during private-deploy bootstrap causing environment permission mismatch
text:
Ephemeral STS session tags dropped during private-deploy bootstrap causing environment permission mismatch

description:
Summary: During a routine bootstrap of a private-deploy runner for customer 'Nimbus Labs', ephemeral AWS STS sessions created by the bootstrap agent are arriving at downstream services with required session tags (team, env, tenant-id) stripped. Impact: services perform an attribute-based allow list check and deny access, preventing the runner from completing initialization and blocking private deploy onboarding. Scope: observed in prod us-west-2 for multiple customers on Private control plane since 2026-03-09 23:00 UTC. Not a user-facing outage yet, but blocks private-deploy onboarding and certain debug flows.

steps_to_reproduce:
1) Trigger private-deploy bootstrap job via control plane for a new on-prem runner in prod-us-west
2) Bootstrap agent requests AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity / AssumeRoleWithSAML or STS AssumeRole and obtains session tokens with session tags (team=platform,env=prod,tenant=nimbus)
3) Agent uses STS creds to call KMS/SecretsManager and to register the runner; downstream service performs iam:TagBased condition check
4) Observe failures in downstream service: AccessDenied due to missing tags reported in logs

logs:
2026-03-09T23:42:01Z bootstrap-agent INFO Obtained STS credentials: AccessKeyId=ASIA..., SessionToken=..., Expiration=2026-03-10T00:42:01Z, TagsRequested=[team:platform,env:prod,tenant:nimbus]
2026-03-09T23:42:03Z secrets-service WARN AccessDenied calling GetSecretValue: Principal does not have required session tags. aws:PrincipalTag/team not present
2026-03-09T23:42:03Z aws-cloudtrail Event: AssumeRole Successful, RequestParameters: {"RoleArn":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/private-deploy-runner","Policy":"..."}, ProvidedTags: []
Snippet: curl call from bootstrap agent shows no X-Amz-Security-Token tags propagated; verified by comparing signed request headers

investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: an intermediate service (token broker) strips session tags when exchanging identity tokens for STS creds.
Verified Control Plane logs: token_broker v2.1.4 was upgraded on 2026-03-09 22:55 UTC; relevant commit referenced in related_github_prs includes a dependency bump for oidc-client which changed header round-tripping behavior.
Checked CloudTrail for AssumeRole calls: PrincipalTags field empty on successful AssumeRole events originating from control plane token broker, but present for direct AssumeRole calls executed by CI in staging.
Reproduced locally by invoking token_broker in a containerized staging environment: when token_broker receives OIDC token with 'x-amzn-oidc-data' containing tags, the exchange path that calls STS omits TagSpecification parameter due to a serialization bug.
RBAC checks at downstream services are strict: org policy enforces aws:PrincipalTag/team and aws:PrincipalTag/tenant for secret access and KMS decrypt.
Risk assessment: high for private onboarding flows and any path relying on principal tags for short-lived credentials. Potential for broader impact if token_broker handles other customer bootstraps.
Workaround tested: manual re-run of bootstrap using a temporary role with inline allow list for account 123456789012 bypassed tag checks and completed successfully (used only for emergency onboarding).

comments:
2026-03-10T01:15Z - Jonah Kim (assignee): Confirmed token_broker v2.1.4 shipping omission for TagSpecification. Created a reproduction container and validated missing tags in STS call; attaching debug trace to PR.
2026-03-10T03:05Z - Priya Shah (SRE): Scoped emergency mitigation: added temporary exception in secrets-service policy to accept principals from bootstrap role for 4 hours. Notified security.
2026-03-10T10:30Z - Marco Diaz (Security): Approved emergency exception for 6 hours with monitoring and audit; requested rollback plan and PR to fix token_broker.
2026-03-11T09:12Z - Jonah Kim: Opened github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/876 to add TagSpecification serialization and unit tests. CI failing on one test related to header encoding.
2026-03-12T16:00Z - Aisha Patel (reporter): Customer contact update: Nimbus Labs onboarding delayed; provided ETA and mitigation steps. Customer accepted manual onboarding with scoped role after security sign-off.

mitigation_and_next_steps:
1) Backport and release token_broker fix that correctly includes TagSpecification when calling STS (PR linked).
2) Add unit and integration tests to validate PrincipalTags in CloudTrail for bootstrap flows.
3) Revoke temporary policy exception after validation and full rollout of fix; audit access during exception window.
4) Add monitoring alert: if AssumeRole CloudTrail event has empty PrincipalTags for private-deploy bootstrap role more than 1/min, trigger P1 pager.
5) Postmortem: update private-deploy runbook to include hotfix path and communication template for affected customers.

resolution:
Mitigation applied: temporary policy exception granted and manual onboarding performed for Nimbus Labs. Token_broker fix merged to main on 2026-03-12 and canary rollout scheduled for 2026-03-13. Final verification pending; when canary shows PrincipalTags present in CloudTrail events and downstream calls succeed, revoke exception and close ticket.

notes_for_followup:
Ensure security performs audit of all secrets access during the exception window (2026-03-10 03:05Z to 2026-03-12 22:00Z).
Add end-to-end test in CI that simulates private-deploy bootstrap and checks CloudTrail for PrincipalTags every merge to main.
Consider adding a defensive header/pass-through test whenever we upgrade oidc-client or token_broker dependencies.
